description: A Streamlit-based Python script implementing a question-answering interface with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for medical textbook content. It manages chat state, loads chapters, retrieves relevant text chunks, and generates AI responses using OpenAI's API.

classes.name: LocalVectorStore
classes.description: A class for managing local vector storage and search operations.

classes.name: EmbeddingManager
classes.description: A class for managing text embeddings and similarity search.

classes.name: AsyncOpenAI
classes.description: A class for asynchronous interaction with OpenAI's API.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an answer to a question using retrieval-augmented generation by fetching relevant text chunks and querying the language model.
